rationale: Borre et al. fed olfactory-bulbectomized rats a mixed diet containing isolated curcumin alongside zinc, melatonin, piperine, EPA, DHA, uridine and choline. Reported cognition and behavioral outcomes are inseparable from the mixture; no ground turmeric, human Parkinson disease or an isolated olfactory treatment effect was assessed. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24286859/
